ai.codriverlabs:scaleout-build-ecs 0.0.9 发布, ECS task orchestration, S3 staging, and native-image input planning. Extracted from
        scaleout-build-maven-plugin so that both the plugin's direct-ECS backend and the
        control-plane service can launch and supervise build tasks without the service having to
        depend on the Maven plugin (and therefore on maven-plugin-api).

        Named for ECS because that is the only backend today. If a second backend appears (see
        docs/design/control-plane/scaleout-builder-control-plane.md's MicroVM note), the launch
        abstraction belongs here and the module is worth renaming then rather than pre-emptively.

        docs/design/control-plane/scaleout-builder-control-plane.md's MicroVM note), the launch
        abstraction belongs here and the module is worth renaming then rather than pre-emptively.

net.cumba:cumba-oss-datatable-testkit 0.5.0 发布, Test helpers for the corej-datatable contract, published as ordinary MAIN code so
        consumers depend on a normal jar instead of a test-jar.

        MockTable builds a Mockito-backed IDataTable from a fluent column spec;
        TestMetadataFixtures builds in-memory IMetadataLibrary / IDataTableMetadata /
        IColumnMetadata / ICodeList fixtures. Both were previously net.cumba.cdisc.core.*
        classes in corej-cdisc-core's TEST tree, reached across the module boundary by a
        test-jar dependency; they name nothing from cdisc-core, so they belong to datatable.

        A published datatable artifact must not carry net.cumba.cdisc.core.* packages: that is
        a permanent split package against cdisc-core's own test tree, and unfixable once on
        Central. Hence net.cumba.datatable.testkit.
